rules: Every authoritative campaign binds to one exact verification handoff.
A mandatory obligation cannot pass without evidence.
Skipped checks must be represented as BLOCKED, WAIVED, FAILED, or INCONCLUSIVE.
Verification environments must be qualified before execution.
Failed and inconclusive results remain immutable after retries.
Flaky results block positive campaign verdicts.
Waivers require authority, justification, risk acceptance, scope, expiry, and compensating controls.
Satisfaction recommendations are produced for R5; BK/R10 does not mutate requirement state directly.
